rows.note: This is the all-purpose possessive form, with context showing that the listener is excluded.

example.english: This decision is ours; it has nothing to do with you.
example.traditional: 呢個決定係我哋嘅，唔關你哋事。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 kyut3 ding6 hai6 ngo5 dei6 ge3 m4 gwaan1 nei5 dei6 si6

rows.note: Use this specifically for our home or place, as in 喺我哋屋企 ‘at ours’.

example.english: Come over to ours for dinner when you're free.
example.traditional: 你得閒就過嚟我哋屋企食飯啦。
example.jyutping: nei5 dak1 haan4 zau6 gwo3 lei4 ngo5 dei6 uk1 kei2 sik6 faan6 laa1
